description: Record the page as frames exactly 1/fps apart on the deterministic clock (time and Math.random are virtual, so a slow software renderer still gives smooth, repeatable frames), after optional steps. Returns a contact sheet of the motion in one picture, the change from frame to frame (a scene that does not move, a frame that pops: a model that appears, a camera cut, a reset), the frames as PNG in .threesmith/capture/<name>/, and an .mp4 when ffmpeg is installed (video: true), else the ffmpeg command. Use it to check an animation, a camera move or a transition, and to make a clip for a trailer or a README.

root.description: folder to serve when the page needs files above its own folder

seed.description: deterministic clock: seed for Math.random; the clock is paused and moves one fixed frame at a time, so every run gives the same frames and pixels

target.description: Folder with the page (index.html), or the http(s) URL of a running dev server.

video.description: encode an .mp4 with ffmpeg when it is installed

name: three_capture
title: Frames of the page, 1/fps apart, with a contact sheet and a video
